exposure: Indication for labor induction/augmentation (clinically indicated, elective)
cohort: The study included 9420 pregnant women from 13 hospitals across India.
finding: PPH was associated with anemia, and among pregnant women with severe anemia, a higher risk of PPH was linked to elective but not clinically indicated labor induction/augmentation.
mod_finding: Elective induction/augmentation of labor was found to increase the risk of PPH in women with severe anemia, but not in those with less severe anemia or when the procedure was clinically indicated.
